semanticsSummary: macro collects all ENGGRP objects with mcount > 0 under a specific tree (/TMS_ENG), iterates over them, and for each group opens an ALPHA output file, writes a tabulated report of all members showing changes since a fixed date (00:00 01 March 2024), then closes the file. Uses PML1 report I/O chain (ALPHA FILE → OUTPUT TABULATE → CHANGES SINCE → ALPHA FILE END).
kbGaps: COLLECT ALL with tree filter (for /tree) — not in KB examples
ALPHA FILE / OUTPUT TABULATE / CHANGES SINCE / ALPHA FILE END report chain — not in KB
ENGGRP object-specific members (.seq, mcount) — not specifically documented
